{{Quote|I trust the younger generation to bring about peace where we have failed. My fuel has been spent keeping what order I could. Fresh talent can now continue where I have left off.|Horox Ryyder, speaking at his retirement ceremony|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_3.html|Senator Horox Ryyder Retires}}</ref>}}
'''Horox Ryyder''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for over 50 [[Standard year/Legends|years]].

==Biography==
[[File:HoroxRyyder2-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|180px|Horox Ryyder was senator of the Raioballo sector.]]
Horox Ryyder was the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]], representing thousands of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] during [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] last term. Ryyder was among the Senators who openly supported Valorum, even though most of the Senate wanted the Chancellor to be replaced.<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

Corruption was rampant in the Senate during this [[Time/Legends|time]], but Ryyder joined a reduced group of senators (also including [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and nominally [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]) who took public measures to end corruption.<ref name="cod" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Chancellor Valorum proposed the taxation of the until then free trade zones. Senator Palpatine then suggested that a part of the collected money could be invested in the growth of planetary systems in the affected areas. Ryyder and other senators of the region, including [[Tendau Bendon/Legends|Tendau Bendon]] and [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]], cheerfully supported the idea.<ref name="cod" />

Soon afterward, Ryyder and his political ally Antilles tried to meet privately with Valorum, but the Chancellor was busy with the upcoming [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] and did not receive them. However, soon afterward, Valorum asked Ryyder, Antilles and Palpatine for advice during a hostage crisis in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. During the meeting, Ryyder analyzed the political implications involving the [[Ancient Houses]] ruling the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], with Antilles and Palpatine proposing measures to be taken.<ref name="cod" />

Horox retired in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and handed the title to the younger [[Zo Howler]] in a semi-private ceremony inviting only his personal friends (such as by-then retired Bail Antilles) and the press. Upon his retirement, Ryyder received the [[Royal Chalcedony Shield]] from his political ally, the new senator of Alderaan, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]; he was one of few non-[[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] to receive the award, in recognition of his dedication to peace.<ref name="HNN" />

He was present at [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] for the [[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]] performance in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Horox Ryyder was a very tall Anx, even for a species reaching four meters in maturity. Ryyder had yellow-green skin and axis-shaped fingers, as well as a bearded head shaped like a crescent moon.<ref name="cod" />

Ryyder was famous in the Senate both for his ability to maintain composure when provoked and for his grasp when faced with complex political matters.<ref name="cardccg">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Horox Ryyder}}</ref>

Horox Ryyder liked dressing in shining crimson clothes and using circular neckbands.<ref name="cod" />

During his time on Coruscant, Ryyder visited the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]], like many other politicians of the time. Ryyder was known to have assisted to a representation of ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'', performed by a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] company.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horox Ryyder was portrayed by [[Jerome Blake]].<ref name="jeromeblake1">{{WebCite|url=http://www.wizardworld.com/jeromeblake.html|text=Jerome Blake biography] in [http://www.wizardworld.com/jeromeblake.html Wizardworld|archivedate=20090728052553}}</ref><ref name="jeromeblake2">{{WebCite|url=http://www.hr-nielsen.dk/Star-Wars-Young-Jedi-Cards-01.html|text=Autographed card|archivedate=20100623041824}}</ref>
